svg.title: When something breaks: where to look, then clean up
svg.desc: When a step fails, pick the place to look by the symptom: the activity log, deployments, resource health and boot diagnostics, sign-in logs, usage and quotas, or Network Watcher. When you are done, delete the resource groups rg-azb-sandbox and rg-azb-lab, delete the Conditional Access policy, keep rg-azb-core and the test users, and check Cost analysis the next day.
